reviews.text:
If I could give more than five stars, I would!

My chihuahua is incredibly fussy, timid, and generally likes to make it clear that new experiences are not on his list of favourite things. Finding a groomer I trust has never been easy, but from the very first visit, it was obvious that Amanda has a real gift with dogs.

Amanda is so patient, calm, and kind, and somehow manages to win over even the most nervous four-legged customers. I honestly don’t know what sort of magic she works, but my dog comes home looking gorgeous, smelling amazing, and with far less drama than I ever expected.

The grooming itself is always fantastic, with so much care and attention to detail, but what I appreciate most is the way Amanda treats the dogs as individuals rather than just another appointment. She genuinely cares, and it shows.

For anyone with a nervous or picky dog who thinks the world is one giant inconvenience designed specifically for them, I couldn’t recommend Amanda more highly. My little diva is in the safest hands possible.

Amanda has been Grooming Alfie for over five years, and does a fantastic job.  For our Bischon she offers different styles to mix up his look from time to time which is fun. Alfie loves his visit and is always calm and happy before, during and after.  I would recommend Amanda, she is warm, kind, caring, and considerate.
Incredible job with my Irish doodle! Will definitely return in the future.

Amanda does a great job. She always lets you know if she has to go shorter and Teddy always come out smelling lovely and with a perfect cut

Thank you Amanda
Tracey

I brought in my 13 week Maltipoo today to get his first puppy groom and honestly I’m so satisfied with the service, Amanda was so lovely and she was also fast. She also gave me great advice on things I need to know about my puppy’s care since it’s my first time owning a puppy. If you’re looking for a groomer I do recommend her 😊🫶🏼 …
